description: Search Thumbtack pros by category and city, paginate across locations and sort orders, or fetch specific profile URLs with background-check, hiring and reputation signals.

backgroundCheckedOnly.description: Keep only pros whose public profile shows a passed background check. Profiles are fetched only for candidates that need checking.
backgroundCheckedOnly.title: Background-checked only

category.description: Thumbtack service category used by search and byCategory modes.
category.title: Service category

city.description: City slug or `City, ST` for the primary search location, e.g. `san-francisco`, `new-york`, or `Austin, TX`.
city.title: City

includeProfileDetails.description: Open each matched pro's profile for background check, years in business, employees, services, credentials, hours, payment methods and reviews. Adds one browser request per record.
includeProfileDetails.title: Include profile details

instantBookOnly.description: Keep only pros whose card advertises instant booking.
instantBookOnly.title: Instant book only

locations.description: Optional list of extra `City, ST` locations. Each becomes its own search page and results are deduplicated, so this is how you paginate past a single city's preview.
locations.title: Additional locations

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted pro records.
maxItems.title: Max items

minHires.description: Keep only pros hired at least this many times through Thumbtack.
minHires.title: Minimum hires

minRating.description: Keep only pros rated at or above this value (0-5).
minRating.title: Minimum rating

minReviews.description: Keep only pros with at least this many customer reviews.
minReviews.title: Minimum reviews

mode.description: Choose how to find pros: a category + location search, a nationwide category sweep, direct profile URLs, or front-door category URLs.
enumTitles: Browse a category across major US cities
mode.title: Mode

paginate.description: When a page returns fewer pros than requested, continue through the remaining sort orders and nearby major cities with deduplication.
paginate.title: Paginate until max items

profileUrls.description: Thumbtack pro profile URLs for mode=byProfile, e.g. `https://www.thumbtack.com/ca/san-francisco/house-cleaning/example/service/123456`.
profileUrls.title: Pro profile URLs

sortBy.description: Server-side order applied to each category page before filters run.
sortBy.title: Sort results by

startUrls.description: Thumbtack front-door category URLs for mode=byUrl, e.g. `https://www.thumbtack.com/tx/austin/plumbers`.
startUrls.title: Category page URLs

state.description: Two-letter state code for the primary search location (mode=search).
state.title: US state

topProOnly.description: Keep only pros carrying the Top Pro badge.
topProOnly.title: Top Pro only

title: Thumbtack Pro Vetting & Hire Signal Scraper Input
